name: manual_ebc4a3
claim: Before fast-forwarding a shared canonical checkout, preserve its state with a named recovery branch and an untracked-inclusive stash

decisions.notes: Canonical worktrees often carry uncommitted or unrelated branch work; a reset or branch switch without a recovery ref and stash silently discards it, whereas ff-only onto a verified descendant commit plus a preserved recovery point is reversible.

rationale: Canonical worktrees often carry uncommitted or unrelated branch work; a reset or branch switch without a recovery ref and stash silently discards it, whereas ff-only onto a verified descendant commit plus a preserved recovery point is reversible.
